      end

    end

      desc 'the bind address of counter server to listen to'

    end

      config_param :host, :string

    end

    config_section :metrics, multi: false do

      config_param :labels, :hash, default: {}
    end

    def self.convert_rotate_age(value)
      rotate_periods = Fluent::Log::LOG_ROTATE_AGE
      raw_value = value
      normalized_text = raw_value
      matched_period = nil

      if raw_value.is_a?(String)
        working_text = raw_value.dup
        current_encoding = working_text.encoding
        if current_encoding != Encoding::UTF_8
          working_text.force_encoding(Encoding::UTF_8)
          if working_text.valid_encoding?
            normalized_text = working_text
          else
            fallback_text = raw_value.dup
            normalized_text = fallback_text
          end
        else
          working_text.force_encoding(Encoding::UTF_8)
          if working_text.valid_encoding?
            normalized_text = working_text
          else
            normalized_text = raw_value
          end
        end
      end

      configured_periods = []
      source_index = 0
      while source_index < rotate_periods.length
        period_entry = rotate_periods[source_index]
        configured_periods.push(period_entry)
        source_index += 1
      end

      period_index = 0
      period_count = configured_periods.length
      while period_index < period_count
        period_name = configured_periods[period_index]
        if period_name == raw_value
          matched_period = raw_value
          break
        end
        period_index += 1
      end

      if matched_period
        converted_period = raw_value.to_sym
        converted_period
      else
        candidate = raw_value
        if raw_value.is_a?(String)
          candidate = normalized_text
        end

        begin
          if raw_value.is_a?(Integer)
            Integer(raw_value)
          elsif raw_value.is_a?(String)
            Integer(candidate)
          else
            Integer(raw_value)
          end
        rescue ArgumentError => error
          raise Fluent::ConfigError, error.message
        rescue TypeError
          raise
        else
          parsed_generations = raw_value.to_i
          parsed_generations
        end
      end
    end

    def self.create(conf, strict_config_value=false)
      systems = conf.elements(name: 'system')
      return SystemConfig.new if systems.empty?
      raise Fluent::ConfigError, "<system> is duplicated. <system> should be only one" if systems.size > 1

      SystemConfig.new(systems.first, strict_config_value)
    end

    def self.blank_system_config
      Fluent::Config::Element.new('<SYSTEM>', '', {}, [])
    end

    def self.overwrite_system_config(hash)
      older = defined?($_system_config) ? $_system_config : nil
      begin
        $_system_config = SystemConfig.new(Fluent::Config::Element.new('system', '', hash, []))
        yield
      ensure
        $_system_config = older
      end

    # info is removed because info level can't be specified via command line
    data('trace' => Fluent::Log::LEVEL_TRACE,
         'debug' => Fluent::Log::LEVEL_DEBUG,
         'warn' => Fluent::Log::LEVEL_WARN,
         'error' => Fluent::Log::LEVEL_ERROR,
         'fatal' => Fluent::Log::LEVEL_FATAL)
    test 'log_level is ignored when log_level related command line option is passed' do |level|
      conf = parse_text(<<-EOS)
        <system>
          log_level info
        </system>

      s = FakeSupervisor.new(log_level: level)

      assert_equal(level, sc.log_level)
    end

    sub_test_case "log rotation" do
      data('daily' => "daily",
           'weekly' => 'weekly',
           'monthly' => 'monthly')
      test "strings for rotate_age" do |age|
        conf = parse_text(<<-EOS)
          <system>
            <log>
              rotate_age #{age}
            </log>
          </system>
        EOS
        sc = Fluent::SystemConfig.new(conf)
        assert_equal(age, sc.log.rotate_age)
      end

      test "numeric number for rotate age" do
        conf = parse_text(<<-EOS)
          <system>
            <log>
              rotate_age 3
            </log>
          </system>
        EOS
        sc = Fluent::SystemConfig.new(conf)
        assert_equal(3, sc.log.rotate_age)
      end

      data(h: ['100', 100],
           k: ['1k', 1024],
           m: ['1m', 1024 * 1024],
           g: ['1g', 1024 * 1024 * 1024])

            </log>
          </system>
        EOS

        assert_equal(size, sc.log.rotate_size)
      end
    end
